10f_1_hermiticity_defect.png: Along the prescribed history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($H = m = 1$), at the fold $z = \pi/2$, for a wave with the coordinate momenta $q_1 = 0.5$ and $q_5 = 0.01$, $0.05$, $0.2$ (blue, orange, green): left, the size of the anti-Hermitian part of the mode Hamiltonian; right, the size of the commutator $Bh - hB$, which mixes the two eigenspaces of $B$. Horizontal axes: the time $x_4$ in units of $1/m$; vertical axes: the size in units of $m$, logarithmic. Dots: measured matrices; lines: the formulas $k_5 = q_5e^{a_4}b_4^{-1/2} = q_5e^{x_4/3}$ and $2k_5$; dotted grey line: the mass. The straight lines show exponential growth: the deflation of the extra times drives every wave with extra-time momentum ever further from a Hermitian, sector-preserving evolution. In the good sector, $q_5 = 0$, both sizes are 0 at every time.
10f_2_eigenvalues_along_history.png: The 16 eigenvalues of the mode Hamiltonian $h(x_4)$ of a wave with the coordinate momenta $q_1 = 0.5$, $q_5 = 0.05$ (no hidden momentum, at the fold $z = \pi/2$) along the prescribed history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($H = m = 1$): real parts (left, blue) and imaginary parts (right, orange), each curve carrying eight eigenvalues; horizontal axes: the time $x_4$ in units of $1/m$, vertical axes in units of $m$. Before the onset time $x_4^\ast = 8.987$ (dotted line) the eigenvalues are the real frequencies $\pm w(x_4)$, which shrink as the extra-time frame momentum grows; at the onset they meet at 0 and then move onto the imaginary axis as $\pm i\kappa(x_4)$, and the growth rate $\kappa$ keeps increasing.
10f_3_inertia_along_history.png: The Krein inertia of the eigenspace of $+w$ of the mode Hamiltonian of the wave $q_1 = 0.5$, $q_5 = 0.05$ (no hidden momentum, at the fold) at each time $x_4$ of the prescribed history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ (horizontal axis, units of $1/m$). Each thin bar splits the eight directions of the eigenspace (vertical axis) into positive charge (blue), negative charge (orange) and neutral (green). Before the onset time $x_4^\ast = 8.987$ (dotted line) the split is 4 and 4 at every instant; after it the whole eigenspace is neutral. The deflation of the extra times moves the wave from the first kind to the second at a definite time.
10f_4_onset_map.png: Left: waves without hidden momentum, $q_1 = 0.5$, $q_5$ from $10^{-3}$ to 1 (vertical axis: $\log_{10}q_5$), at the fold, along the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ (horizontal axis: the time $x_4$, units of $1/m$): light blue where the frequency is real (inertia (4, 4)), light orange where it is imaginary (Krein-neutral, growth); grey curve: the onset time; green dashed lines: the five slices $a_{4,0}$ of the Kohn-Sham record. Right: waves with the coordinate momenta $q_0$ (horizontal axis) and $q_5$ (vertical axis), $q_1 = 0.5$, at $z = \pi/4$: where $D = 2^{1/6}q_5^2 - q_0^2 > 0$ (above the grey line) the colour is the onset time, darker for earlier; where $D \leq 0$ (light blue) the wave never grows. Without hidden momentum every extra-time wave grows; a large enough hidden momentum prevents it.
10f_5_good_sector_energies.png: The good sector along the prescribed history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($H = m = 1$) for the coordinate momenta $q_1 = 0.5$, 1, 2, 4 without hidden momentum (blue, orange, green, grey, at the fold) and for $q_0 = 0.5$, $q_1 = 1$ at $z = \pi/4$ (orange dashed); horizontal axes: the time $x_4$ in units of $1/m$. Left: the normal-ordered energy $E(x_4) = \sqrt{m^2 + k_0^2 + k_1^2}$ of one particle or one antiparticle of the instantaneous Fock space; without hidden momentum it falls towards the mass $m$ (dotted line) as 3-space inflates, with hidden momentum it rises again because the hidden direction shrinks; right: the value $-8E(x_4)$ of the filled sea. Vertical axes in units of $m$. Dots: computed from the eigenvectors at the five slices of the Kohn-Sham record. In the good sector every quantum has a positive energy at every time, and the Krein inertia stays (4, 4).
